text:
maria_su: Hey team — customer hitting intermittent failures on embeddings endpoint. Error: "dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024" when sending batches from our TS SDK. Happens only on larger batches (>= 50).

support-bot: Ticket #INC-4981 created (priority: high). Assigned to @alex_support.

alex_support: Thanks @maria_su, can you paste the minimal repro and the exact model name + SDK version? Also any request_id/trace ids from the logs would help.

maria_su: Repro snippet (TS) the customer shared:
```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const texts = Array.from({length: 60}).map((_,i)=>`embedding text ${i}`);
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'text-embedding-3-large',
  input: texts,
});
```
Logs show: "400 Bad Request - dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024" for ~15% of requests. SDK version: 1.4.2. Customer also uses a local batcher that groups variable-length inputs into single request.

alex_support: couple quick checks: 1) confirm the model is actually deployed as text-embedding-3-large (server-side may have been rolled back to v2 with diff dims), 2) are they mixing different model names across retries? 3) any proxies/middleware altering payloads?

maria_su: They've confirmed model param is text-embedding-3-large everywhere. No proxies. They reported retries happening from their side when timeout occurs — retry policy is exponential with no dedupe token.

tim_eng_ml: Flagging a known integration pitfall: older embedding model variants used 1024 dims. If any request is routed to an older model variant due to rollout/fallback, your per-item dim expectation will mismatch when the SDK assumes one uniform dim. Also concurrency in the SDK batcher can interleave responses if request->response mapping relies on array indices rather than explicit per-item ids.

dev-rel: Can we ask customer to run single-item requests to confirm model dims quickly? e.g.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Should return vector length 1536 if using 3-large.

maria_su: They ran that: single-item returns length 1536 always. Only batched multi-item requests sometimes return 1024 for a subset.

alex_support: That points to a batching or routing mismatch. Two hypotheses: (A) server-side batcher coalesces requests to backends with mixed model variants during a rollout and attaches responses in a different order, or (B) client SDK bug: responses from multiplexed HTTP/2 stream are being handled by worker A but matched to batch indices from worker B.

olga_runtime: I'll pull server logs for the time windows. Please collect a few request_ids from failing transcripts — I need the inbound request ids and the response ids. If customer can't provide, ask them to enable X-Request-Id in headers and retry to capture. Also share timestamps (approx).

maria_su: Provided one example id: req_2026-11-03T14:02:03Z id=RDX-7f4c2a. Attached chunk of their client logs showing concurrent batch sends:
```
[14:02:03.120] batcher: flush batch(60) -> POST /v1/embeddings id=RDX-C-1
[14:02:03.121] http: send stream id=7
[14:02:03.150] batcher: flush batch(48) -> POST /v1/embeddings id=RDX-C-2
[14:02:03.151] http: send stream id=9
[14:02:03.450] http: resp stream id=7 status=200 len=921600
[14:02:03.451] parser: assign resp->batch RDX-C-2
[14:02:03.452] http: resp stream id=9 status=200 len=614400
[14:02:03.453] parser: assign resp->batch RDX-C-1
```

alex_support: That log snippet strongly suggests an index-mapping race — parser matched stream ids incorrectly to batches. Looks like SDK 1.4.2 has a regression in the HTTP/2 multiplexing code. Can you ask them to upgrade to 1.5.0-rc which contains a fix for stream->batch mapping? If they need a hotfix, we can patch 1.4.x quickly.

maria_su: Customer can't upgrade immediately due to enterprise constraints. They asked for a short-term mitigation.

tim_eng_ml: Mitigation options: 1) fall back to synchronous single-item requests (slower) 2) throttle batch concurrency to 1 (ensure only one batch in-flight) 3) add an application-level per-item id and server-side validation to detect dim mismatches and reject instead of mixing.

alex_support: For timeouts/retries side-effect — if their retry logic blindly resubmits the same batch without idempotency keys, retries can hit different model variants or duplicate entries. Recommend they set dedupe token in header X-Client-Dedupe or use the SDK's retry wrapper that sets idempotency-key per batch.

maria_su: I'll propose two paths to customer: (A) immediate throttle concurrency to 1 and add a small jittered backoff to avoid hotspots, (B) we arrange an emergency backport hotfix to 1.4.x to fix stream mapping. Which one should we push?

olga_runtime: Please provide the failing request_ids and I will confirm whether any server-side model variant mismatches occurred. If all server-side logs show consistent routing, we will prioritize the SDK patch.

maria_su: Collected 3 request ids and sent to @olga_runtime. Also asked customer to enable X-Request-Id and to run a small validation script to verify vector lengths across 200 batched items with concurrency=1.

dev-rel: Small repro script they can run quickly (TS):
```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.KEY });
async function check() {
  const inputs = Array.from({length:200}).map((_,i)=>`x${i}`);
  const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embedding-3-large', input: inputs, timeout: 30000 });
  for (const v of res.data) {
    if (v.embedding.length !== 1536) {
      console.error('BAD DIM', v.embedding.length); return;
    }
  }
  console.log('all good');
}
check();
```

alex_support: Thanks. Action items:
- maria_su: confirm mitigation with customer (throttle concurrency) and collect more request_ids if problems persist.
- olga_runtime: check server routing for RDX-7f4c2a + others, confirm/deny mixed-variant routing.
- eng-ml (tim): prepare a 1.4.x hotfix diff for stream mapping bug if server logs clear.
- dev-rel: prepare a short KB article on embeddings batch best practices (idempotency, concurrency, model pinning).

maria_su: Will update customer and report back. :thumbsup:

alex_support: Thanks — keep thread updated. If you get stack traces or raw HTTP headers from the customer, paste them here.

maria_su: Follow-up (after throttling to concurrency=1) — customer reports failures dropped to ~0.2% and they can tolerate that while we triage. They will schedule an upgrade window.

alex_support: Great. Marking as in-progress.

olga_runtime: Server logs show no evidence of routing to older model variants for provided ids — leaning toward SDK bug. I'll coordinate with engineering to prioritize the patch.

maria_su: Customer scheduled upgrade to 1.5.0-rc next week. Closing loop soon.
